task: Agree account goals, scope, owners and capacity
dependency: Client kickoff; current fulfillment and Asana process
metric: Approved account plan and task acceptance criteria
evidence: Role describes account ownership, Asana, QA and partner coordination.
acceptanceCriteria: One account brief records commercial goals, constraints, owners, scope questions and reporting cadence; no assumed output quota.

task: Reconcile measurement and save commercial baselines
dependency: Requires Internal Access: GA4, Shopify, GSC, finance; 90D-01
metric: Event integrity, order reconciliation and cohort baseline completeness
evidence: Public revenue claims cannot replace account definitions or baseline exports.
acceptanceCriteria: Document channels, attribution, net-sales/refund treatment, time zones and comparison windows; flag missing/duplicated purchases and annotate affected periods.

task: Validate index controls and representative templates
dependency: Requires Internal Access: GSC; public HTML, sitemap and browser checks
metric: Index/canonical exceptions and template QA coverage
evidence: The 20-page public sample is accessible; selected canonicals and field/mobile evidence remain unvalidated.
acceptanceCriteria: Join sitemap to index evidence, inspect a representative set, distinguish source/rendered checks, and assign only verified defects with owners.

dependency: Requires Internal Access: catalog, stock, margin and query data; 90D-02
metric: Approved intent-to-collection brief with commercial constraints
evidence: Collection-first methodology is public; no hypothetical merchant assortment was verified.
acceptanceCriteria: Save target-market intent evidence, existing-page decision, approved product set, stock/margin input and success/stop criteria.

task: Ship the observed editorial/template QA batch
evidence: Repeated branding, one incomplete meta description and dated platform instructions have direct public evidence.
acceptanceCriteria: Apply branding once, complete the description, refresh specific instructions from primary guidance and verify published HTML; record release/date.

task: Confirm content and authority partner handoffs
metric: Approved briefs and named review/approval owners
evidence: Job and current service messaging have different emphases for blogs and links.
acceptanceCriteria: Document when partners are used, account rationale, brief format, factual sources, voice, link destinations and approval gates.

task: Baseline AI tests and community listening
dependency: Agreed query panel and approved community policy; 90D-01
metric: Saved repeated outputs and community-fit decision log
evidence: AI monitoring and Reddit are public pillars; no client outputs were provided.
acceptanceCriteria: Record model/surface, date, locale, conditions and citations; map buyer questions and current community rules; do not post before disclosure/approval gates.

task: Build and release the first collection pilot
metric: Released viable-intent cohort; all release gates passed
evidence: Proposed account pilot follows the public audit/build/review sequence.
acceptanceCriteria: Brief, products, copy, metadata, URLs, inventory and measurement are approved; independent mobile/purchase-path QA and rollback record are complete.

task: QA facets, internal links and schema on the pilot
owner: Technical SEO + Schema Specialist + Independent QA
metric: Validated URL policy, product discovery and visible schema parity
evidence: Platform eligibility and crawl policies must be verified separately from JSON syntax.
acceptanceCriteria: Verify crawlable product links/pagination, allowed facets, preferred URLs and actual Product/Offer facts on PDPs; do not promise collection stars or AI inclusion.

task: Repair feed blockers, then pilot one product-title change
dependency: Requires Internal Access: Merchant Center and tracking; 90D-02; client scope
metric: Eligibility, free-listing response and reconciled cohort outcomes
evidence: Public founder commentary supports testing supplemental feeds and presentation.
acceptanceCriteria: Resolve critical diagnostics, lock eligible/stocked cohort, record control/comparison design and title change; reserve image changes for a separate release.

dependency: Full rendered graph, navigation intent and baseline; 90D-03
metric: Destination QA and qualified visitor next steps
evidence: Public graph suggests a limited discovery-path test; existing proof links already work as a base.
acceptanceCriteria: Agree one selected hub/path, add only contextually useful links, verify anchors/destinations/mobile operation and annotate the release.

dependency: 90D-02; sufficient cohort data and client scope
metric: Relevant funnel step and commercial outcome
evidence: Public UX observations are hypotheses; no measured friction or conversion rate is available.
acceptanceCriteria: Choose agency lead or merchant purchase funnel explicitly, set primary outcome/guardrails, preserve context and avoid simultaneous uncontrolled changes.

task: Compare released cohorts and investigate confounders
metric: Query response, landing purchases, net sales, stock and margin context
evidence: Attributed outcomes do not by themselves establish incremental effects.
acceptanceCriteria: Compare agreed periods/cohorts, annotate promotions/seasonality/stock, separate Search from Shopping and document uncertainty; do not force a positive result.

task: Repeat AI/community observations and revise hypotheses
metric: Repeated citations, genuine mentions and qualified referrals reported separately
evidence: Public positioning does not prove stable AI visibility or community causality.
acceptanceCriteria: Repeat consistent prompt conditions, save exact outputs, classify mentions/citations/referrals separately and pause unsupported tactics.

dependency: Completed pilot, release evidence and Asana access
metric: Independent handoff success, rework and visible dependencies
evidence: Documentation and future leadership are explicit role requirements.
acceptanceCriteria: A second operator follows the brief and QA checklist; capture missing context, account exceptions and capacity before broader rollout.

task: Run the 90-day strategy review with the client
evidence: Quarterly recalibration is publicly stated; the proposed review converts reporting into a revised plan.
acceptanceCriteria: Close each hypothesis with evidence and uncertainty, explain business implications, agree next-quarter priorities/owners and archive the decision log.
